edits.before: Chaguo zote hukokotoa uga uleule sahihi.
edits.after: Machaguo yote hukokotoa uga uleule sahihi.
edits.rationale: Use an explicit machaguo plural and matching ma-class concord instead of inconsistent chaguo with zi-/nyingine.
Fallback uses CPU as substitute route, not a repeated CPU attempt; plural label describes event count.

edits.before: Muziki bado haujahifadhiwa daima. Jaribu kuhifadhi tena kabla ya kuondoka.
edits.after: Muziki bado haujahifadhiwa kwa kudumu. Jaribu kuhifadhi tena kabla ya kuondoka.
edits.rationale: Permanent storage uses idiomatic kwa kudumu rather than daima/always.

editor_notes: All99 entries read. Explicit choices plural aligned with machaguo; CPU fallback is a substitute computation route, not a repeat/retry (Marudio). Permanent storage uses idiomatic kwa kudumu. Technical identifiers CPU/GPU/MCP/JSON/Opus and simulation boundary behavior preserved. No guarantee of native fluency or rendering fit.
certification: Agent edited; not native-human-certified; rendering/platform gates separate
